question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

No institutional trigger exists ahead of the 21st Party Congress expected in autumn 2027, while recent military leadership changes and personnel appointments have reinforced rather than undermined his authority through loyalty enforcement. Public appearances and policy continuity through mid-2026 show no factional challenge or health indicators capable of prompting elite realignment. Historical patterns tie major leadership shifts to scheduled congresses rather than abrupt ousters. Realistic disruptions remain limited to an unforeseen medical event, severe economic downturn generating internal consensus against him, or external crisis fracturing elite cohesion before December 2026.
